title: Too Late to Prune: Generative AI, the Screen, and Team Creative Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.14984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI makes options cheap and shifts the bottleneck of creative work from generating options to screening them. We argue that AI's value depends on whether its options arrive before or after the team's screen. In our model, early options compete for a place in the portfolio; late options arrive after that competition and are kept unscreened. In a preregistered experiment, we randomly assigned 148 three-person teams to five schedules of access to the same language model during a product-design task with timed search and selection stages. Moving the same 15 minutes of access from search to selection lowered expert-rated creativity by 0.62 standard deviations, although teams used the model at similar rates. Platform logs locate the difference at the screen. Early access enlarged the pool of ideas fivefold, and teams pruned it. Late-access teams reached the screen with the same small pool as teams without AI and then searched again

translated_title: 为时已晚：生成式AI、创意筛选与团队创意决策
translated_abstract: 生成式AI使备选方案变得廉价，并将创造性工作的瓶颈从生成方案转移到了筛选方案。我们认为，AI的价值取决于其提供的方案是在团队筛选环节之前还是之后到达。在我们的模型中，早期到达的方案会竞争进入方案组合的一席之地；而晚期到达的方案则是在这场竞争之后才出现，因而未经筛选就被保留下来。在一项预注册实验中，我们将148个三人团队随机分配到五种不同的时间安排下访问同一语言模型，任务是一项包含限时搜索阶段和选择阶段的产品设计任务。将同样的15分钟AI访问时间从搜索阶段移至选择阶段，会使专家评定的创造力降低0.62个标准差，尽管各团队使用模型的频率相近。平台日志将这一差异定位于筛选环节：早期访问使创意池扩大了五倍，团队随之对其进行筛选淘汰；而晚期访问团队则是带着与未使用AI团队相同的小创意池进入筛选环节，之后再重新进行搜索。
tldr: 生成式AI对团队创造力的价值取决于介入时机：在筛选之前的搜索阶段使用AI能通过“先扩充创意池、再筛选淘汰”显著提升创造力，而筛选之后才获得同样的AI访问则因创意未经筛选而使专家评定的创造力降低0.62个标准差。
en_tdlr: Generative AI enhances team creativity only when its ideas arrive before the team's screening stage—enlarging the idea pool fivefold for pruning—whereas the same 15 minutes of AI access provided after the screen arrives too late to prune and instead lowers expert-rated creativity by 0.62 standard deviations.
